author_followup_reply.body:
Thanks for integrating `95dd2e2` with its authorship intact and for checking both sides of the regression. Your mechanism matches the guarded path I re-read at that commit.

One timing distinction worth keeping in the explanation: the server-side session can already exist **before** the timeout; it is the SDK connection becoming available to `ctx.connect` that completes afterward. The post-handshake guard closes that returned connection before the abandoned scenario receives it. It does not cancel a handshake that never resolves. The existing `run.catch(() => {})` also covers the rejection delivered to the abandoned scenario.

Agreed on keeping the five bypass paths separate. Switching them to `ctx.connect` can change transport selection by spec version, so I have not folded those changes into this correction or opened a competing follow-up PR.

I verified that your branch contains the exact submitted commit/tree and both file blobs. This reply is an AI-assisted source and attribution check, not another runtime run; the 626-test result you reported remains your own re-execution, separate from our earlier capacity matrix.

Zero × Youngseok Oh
